appearance_facts.fact: Title reads 'Public Service Feedback Share by Category'.
Vertical axis is labeled 'Value' with numeric ticks from 0 to 65 in increments of 5.
Horizontal axis is labeled 'Feedback Category' with six category labels: Service Quality, Service Cost, Service Design, Support Access, Service Delivery, and Other.
A blue circular marker sits at the Service Quality column, positioned near the 60 gridline, with a text label '52%' above it.
A blue circular marker sits at the Service Cost column, positioned near the 50 gridline, with a text label '51%' above it.
A blue circular marker sits at the Service Design column, positioned just below the 50 gridline, with a text label '12%' above it.
A blue circular marker sits at the Support Access column, positioned near the 35 gridline, with a text label '17%' above it.
A blue circular marker sits at the Service Delivery column, positioned near the 50 gridline, with a text label '42%' above it.
